bullets.text: Scientists believe a collapsed glacier likely caused the devastating floods in Nepal and Tibet, which have left hundreds dead or missing. This event highlights the ongoing issue of rapidly melting Himalayan ice.
A Bosnian Serb war criminal, convicted of genocide and crimes against humanity, has died at the age of 84. He was jailed for life in 2017 for his role in the wars in the former Yugoslavia.
The Board of Peace's Gaza envoy has criticized both Israeli strikes and Hamas actions, warning that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be a "point of no return" for the region.

The federal government has pledged $5 million in humanitarian aid to support disaster recovery efforts in the Himalayas following a deadly flood, as the number of Australians missing in the region has risen to 39.
Experts are advocating for increased education on the dangers of strangulation after the death of a Sydney teenage girl, which is believed to be linked to a suspected sexual choking act.
A charity named Second Chances, which supports prisoners' children, may be forced to close due to government funding cuts, despite the government directly referring people to their services.
US bank regulators are set to narrow their enforcement focus to financial risks as part of a wider deregulatory push under the Trump administration.
Nvidia Corp. saw a $442 billion increase in its market value, marking the second-largest one-day gain by any stock in history and fueling a rally in tech stocks amid confidence in the AI trade.
Donald Trump's immigration crackdown is projected to lead to a smaller workforce and slower economic growth in the US, according to an analysis of its economic costs.
